text:
What happens when you put 30 ambitious teams in one room for 24 hours?

Ideas become prototypes.

That’s Click-a-Thon at Polaris.

author: polariscampus
text:
24 hours. Countless ideas. One unforgettable experience.

It was about more than just coding. It was about building, learning, collaborating, and turning ideas into reality. Every challenge became an opportunity, and every conversation sparked something new.

author: thepolarisfellowship
text:
@brightmoney.co joins The Polaris Fellowship as an Ecosystem Partner. 🤝🏻

Built at the intersection of AI and personal finance, Bright Money uses its proprietary MoneyScience AI engine, powered by 34 intelligent algorithms, to help users pay off debt, optimize cash flow, build credit, and make smarter financial decisions in real time.

Instead of relying on fixed budgeting rules, Bright Money continuously analyzes spending patterns, predicts cash flow, and automates financial decisions while protecting users from overdrafts.

It’s a powerful example of how AI can solve real-world problems at scale, making financial systems more intelligent, personalized, and accessible.

We’re proud to welcome Bright Money to the growing Polaris Fellowship ecosystem, alongside founders, operators, investors, and some of the world’s most ambitious technology companies.

#ThePolarisFellowship #BrightMoney #Ai #Startup

author: thepolarisfellowship
text:
@aftershootco joins The Polaris Fellowship as an Ecosystem Partner. 🤝

Built for modern photographers, Aftershoot is reimagining photo editing with AI that works entirely on your own computer. Unlike most AI editing tools, your images never leave your device - making the workflow faster, more private, and significantly more sustainable.

In a world where AI is increasingly cloud-first, Aftershoot is proving that powerful AI can also be privacy-first. 

Their local AI approach is changing how creative professionals edit, cull, and deliver thousands of photos while keeping complete control of their data.

We’re proud to welcome Aftershoot to the growing Polaris Fellowship ecosystem, alongside founders, operators, investors, and some of the world’s most ambitious technology companies.

author: polariscampus
text:
Most students wait until their final year to start building a career. Polaris students are doing it in Year 1.

₹1 Cr+ in stipends, 109 opportunities, 35 global open-source selections, and internships across 11 countries.

This isn’t a placement report. It’s what happens when you focus on proof of work from Day 1.

author: polariscampus
text:
What is the strongest tangible proof of coding competence in real-world scenarios?

Open Source it is. Which is strongly engraved into the culture of Polaris.

This year, 18 Polaris students became part of that culture through Google Summer of Code 2026.

And they’re not just contributing locally. They’re now working across open-source ecosystems spanning 9 countries, contributing to real-world systems in:
- cybersecurity
- healthcare & genomics
- developer infrastructure
- ⁠geospatial systems
- ⁠programming languages

Working alongside experienced mentors, building systems used by developers and organizations across the world.

But behind every selection is a completely different story.
While some students started with utmost clarity, some rebuilt from scratch after setbacks. Some learned by breaking things, fixing them, and trying again.
What connects all of them is simple:
They showed up consistently.
 They kept building.
